items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: It seems to me the Spirituals to Swing, (inaudible) with Basie and Leadbelly was before the Goodman Concert.

ctx.x: But there is another concert that took place before both of those, which I can't recall the name of. But I think, Milt, you told me about it. Something maybe as early as 1928. I don't know if it was in Carnegie Hall.
It seems to me the Spirituals to Swing, (inaudible) with Basie and Leadbelly was before the Goodman Concert. Maybe wasn't.

Well, the ones that I have, I just recorded, according to the notes, they were sponsored by John Hammond. According to the notes they took place in two years, they were December of 1938 and December of 1939.
